entities.name: Safia Ahmed-jan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Safia Amajan, also spelt Ama-jan, Ama Jan, Ahmed-jan and Ahmed Jan, was an Afghan women's rights activist, educator, politician, and critic of the Taliban's suppression of women, who was shot and killed in 2006, reportedly by the Taliban.
